svg.title: (f) Registered mesh links — 2 × 2 fragment of the N × N array
svg.text: (f) Registered mesh links — 2 × 2 fragment of the N × N array
Each neighbor pair has separate W-bit operand links and P-bit partial-sum links. The shown register slices belong to the transmitting PE.
OS selects local accumulator feedback. WS selects the northern partial sum. IS selects the western partial sum.
Edge collectors tap the current sum before the link flop. Boundary sums are zero; inactive-direction sums are written with zero. Full PE muxes: panel (b).
